description: Pedro Martinez named All-Star Game MVP, striking out 5 of the 6 batters he faced - including the first four in a row: Barry Larkin, Larry Walker, Sammy Sosa, and Mark McGwire.
17-inning marathon - the scorecard runs to a continuation sheet for the extra innings.
Delayed 45 minutes by lightning and again for the threat of a thunderstorm before the 6th, Clay Buchholz pitched a complete-game shutout.
Went to extra innings - Grady Sizemore's walk-off single in the 12th drove in David Ortiz for the win.
Umpire Jordan Baker ejected Orioles pitcher Ubaldo Jimenez for hitting Pablo Sandoval with a pitch, with no warning issued beforehand.
David Ortiz hit his 498th career home run, a three-run shot capping a four-run third inning.
Umpire Sam Holbrook ejected Orioles outfielder Adam Jones for arguing a check-swing/hit-by-pitch call after Jones was hit by a pitch in the 5th inning.
In the 9th, Mookie Betts hit what would have been a game-tying double, but it bounced into the stands for a ground-rule double instead, stranding the tying run at third.
Wilyer Abreu hit an inside-the-park grand slam in the 5th inning - one of the rarest plays in baseball.
In the 1st inning, Nate Eaton's would-be home run hit the ladder on the Green Monster and was ruled a double instead.
Garrett Crochet pitched a complete-game shutout, all 9 innings.
Game went to extra innings (10) - in the 10th, Trevor Story threw out Chas McCormick at home plate.
